name: pilot-release-bundle-readiness
purpose: Compute whether a multi-change release bundle is ready for explicit promotion without invoking a deployment provider.

rules.ready: READY only when every included source package has a PASSED required verification result and the bundle manifest is complete.
rules.blocked: Any missing, failed, or blocked required verification result produces BLOCKED with deterministic reasons.
rules.no_deployment: Readiness evaluation must not invoke the deployment adapter.
rules.traceability: Readiness evidence must identify every included package and verification result.
rules.promotion: READY permits consideration for APPROVED_FOR_RELEASE but does not itself approve or deploy.
